name: Next-Gen Manufacturing Academy (High School Summer Academy)
what_you_do: Summer days on campus building skills in engineering, robotics and AI, including smart robots. No experience needed.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors interested in engineering, robotics or AI. Bonita Unified School District students get priority.
pay_detail: $25 per person. Parking permit and daily lunch included.
duration: Held each July, daily 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., at Cal Poly Pomona Building 17
deadline_text: Page says applications open in January and close in April each year. Exact 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Email the RASIM Center at rasim@cpp.edu to sign up during the January to April window.
notes: The page's sample schedule is labeled Summer 2027 but gives no exact dates. Confirm by email.
